name: What are the advantages of investing in a fourplex compared to a duplex or triplex?

mainEntity.name: What are the advantages of investing in a fourplex compared to a duplex or triplex?

acceptedAnswer.text: Investing in a fourplex typically offers a higher income potential due to more rental units compared to a duplex (two units) or triplex (three units). This can lead to increased cash flow and a stronger return on investment. However, managing four units also means more potential tenant issues and maintenance demands. When considering an investment in areas like Miami-Dade or Broward County, a fourplex can help maximize property utilization in desirable locations.
acceptedAnswer.description: A fourplex offers higher income potential than duplexes or triplexes but involves more management. In competitive markets like Miami-Dade, it can maximize returns.
